Baldi:
Baldi's Basics
(2018-Present)

A game series started from a game jam submission but now into TWO games, one is a roguelike game called Baldi's Basics + and the other is a remaster to the classic, Baldi's Basics Classic Remastered. I love this game for the design-choices and such, being based on old edutainment videogame, mostly uses ALOT of 3D model, this game also spawned a somewhat big modding scene that managed to hold this game of popularity. Good game, I recommend you to play the BB+.
BlockTale:
Block Tales
(2024-Present)

A roblox game that is a turn-based RPG and really inspired by Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door and mostly early Roblox years. as of currently writing this, it's on Demo 4 and it's still ongoing, I won't spoil anything but pretty much fun turn-based RPG game on Roblox.
Dandy:
Dandy's World
(2024-Present)

A roblox game that's a Mascot horror survival game where you go down each floors, extracting every machine while not dying, I love the design of the characters which are called Toons as they have to survive their corrupted counterpart called Twisted. The game is kinda eh? It's just painfully boring but fun with other peoples, and I mostly like the characters' design more than the game :/
Deltarune:
Deltarune
(2018-Present)

A RPG game that was made after UNDERTALE, the story and idea was made before 2011, so straight up even before UNDERTALE, the game is currently updates per chapter and right now as of writing this, we are on chapter 3&4. I love the character developments, design and the worldbuilding of it, also has like really good sense of humors such as
YOU'RE TAKING TOO LONG
and such it's a pretty good game, you should try the Chapter 1 & 2 Demo first then pay later for futures chapters.
Ena:
Ena
(2020-Present)

ENA is an animated series and now has a game called “ENA Dream BBQ.” for the animated series, the story consist of an objective that is stated or shown at the beginning then at the end it did, but the middle one is unique because the dialogues, characters and the world is majorly different and surreal entirely, for the game, it's currently as of writing this, just released with single chapter, the main objective of the game is to find the boss and you meet bunch of side-characters in your way, and their design is really unique. You should try playing it!
PVZ:
Plants vs. Zombies
(2009-Present)

A game that is a tower defense genre where you defends your house with plants against zombies, I like the gameplay of it of being “casual” and somewhat easy to strategize. It felt it was sorta better than Plants Vs. Zombies 2 since it was made before EA enquired Popcap and isn't just mobile-exclusive. but I do like the plants design in that game but seemly it looks more bad with premiums as of now they just adds PvZ1 content to it and it doesn't fit well.
